description: [Darren's] integrity, consistency, hard-work ethic, and solid judgment are part of his nature. He is one of the most effective leaders I have worked with because of his unique ability to break down a problem with his engineering background and create solutions that last.... His history of serving the community is well established and I welcome his leadership in our state government as he will rise to the top of any organization that he serves.
title: Steve Crandall - Darren Croft for Utah House District 41
